title: "Driving a Rolls Royce": The Man Using Earl Thomas's Name
template: verbatim quote + how he got caught

lines.say: More than seven hundred thousand dollars, withdrawn in Earl Thomas's name, reports say. Then the man behind it drove a Rolls-Royce to the credit union.
lines.show: More than $700,000, withdrawn in Earl Thomas's name, reports say. Then the man behind it drove a Rolls-Royce to the credit union.

scene.label: WITHDRAWN IN HIS NAME|THEN: THE ROLLS-ROYCE

lines.say: The credit union had already called the sheriff. Kevin Thompson arrived in a Rolls-Royce fraudulently obtained from the victim.
The account was in the victim's name. The phone number was Thompson's.
This month, he and Thomas's estranged wife pleaded guilty.
Should the bank have caught it sooner? Tell me below.
